# AIQTP™ — AI Quantum Trading Platform

> Public AIQTP pages only. Authenticated trading, admin, wallet, account, and backend surfaces are intentionally excluded.

AIQTP is an AI and quantum-focused trading platform. Public pages describe pricing, legal terms, performance, launch information, rewards, and marketplace-style NFT content. Live account data, payments, portfolios, wallets, admin operations, and trading tools require authentication and are not advertised to AI crawlers here.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Public platform overview.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans, fees, and public pricing information.
- [Legal](/legal): Terms of service and privacy policy.
- [Fees](/fees): Fee schedule and cost disclosures.
- [Performance](/performance): Public platform performance presentation.
- [Stats](/stats): Public rewards and activity arena.
- [Rewards](/rewards): Public rewards store information.

## Launches

- [Launch](/launch): Public AIQTP token launch page.
- [NFT Drop](/nft-drop): Public NFT drop page.
- [Live Snapshot](/go): Public live platform snapshot backed by database records.
- [Strategy NFT](/strategy-nft): Public strategy NFT marketplace entry point.
